town_description: Rajkot is the fourth-largest city of Gujarat and a major commercial, industrial and educational hub of the Saurashtra region. Once the capital of the princely state of Rajkot and an administrative centre of the Saurashtra region, it is also the city where Mahatma Gandhi spent his early years. The city is well connected by air (Rajkot International Airport at Hirasar), rail (Rajkot Junction) and road (NH-27).
